|quest_reward4_quest = Fallen from Grace |quest_reward4_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Desecrate''' is a [[spell]] that summons [[corpse]]s and a patch of [[desecrated ground]], which deals [[chaos]] [[damage over time]] to enemies in the area. ==Skill functions and interactions== * The level of the spawned corpses is determined by the lower value between [[area level]] and Desecrate's {{c|mod|Spawns corpses up to Level #}} stat.{{cite web|author=Mark_GGG|date=March 6, 2014|title=Skill Feedback - Desecrate|url=https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/784330/page/5#p7063348|publisher=Official Path of Exile Forums|accessdate=March 7, 2014}} The corpse's level cannot exceed the area level or maximum corpse level based on Desecrate's level. * Desecrate's chaos damage over time is not affected by modifiers to [[spell damage]]. It ''is'' affected by area damage modifiers. * Modifiers to [[area of effect]] only affect the area of the {{stl|Desecrated Ground}}'s damaging area; it does not affect the spread distance of spawned corpses. * {{il|Spell Cascade Support}}: Spell Cascade spawns 5 corpses per cascaded area. Because of this, a single use will exceed the maximum limit of 10 corpses (or 12 with [[Undertaker]] allocated); newer corpses will replace older corpses. * The corpse generation is slightly delayed after the cast of the skill, so when [[trigger]]ed simultaneously alongside an [[Offering]] skill (e.g. with {{il|Cast when Damage Taken Support}}), corpses will not be consumed on the first trigger if no other corpses are nearby, as the Offering will fail to recognize that the corpses have spawned.https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/2474665/page/1#p21831501 This does not affect triggers where gems are triggered sequentially, such as {{il|Cast on Critical Strike Support}}. * [[Proxies]] share the maximum 10 active corpses with each other and the player. * On a PC, if Corpse Targeting is enabled within the Options menu (under "Game"), pressing the {{key press|A}} key will show the name and inherent stats of the corpse when the player hovers their mouse over it. This can be changed to a different key or not requiring a key in the options. ====Interactions with Raise Spectre==== Desecrate's pool of corpses depends on whether the player has socketed '''and''' previously used {{il|Raise Spectre}}, as well as the player's current area: {| class="wikitable" |+ Corpse pool distribution |- ! They cannot be detonated, consumed, or otherwise affected by non-minion skills other than by overriding the corpse limit by using Desecrate or [[Death Walk]]. ====Spectre bank==== A "[[Raise_Spectre#"Spectre_bank"|spectre bank]]" is an internal list of the 10 most recent monsters raised by a {{il|Raise Spectre}} gem. This number is independent of your maximum spectre limit. This list is retained even upon exiting the area, removing the Raise Spectre gem, after your Spectres die or are unsummoned, or logging out. There is currently no way to clear a spectre bank; it can only be ignored by removing the Raise Spectre gem. Spectral Corpses will only be created if at least one monster is in your spectre bank. Before 10 or more different monsters are saved in the spectre bank, each additional spectre saved dilutes the chance for the Spectral Corpse to be a specific spectre. After 10 or more spectres are saved, the chance does not get further diluted, and the oldest monster saved will be removed from the spectre bank. To share spectres between players, the players should join the same [[hideout]] area. After doing so, either player will be able to spawn spectral corpses of other players in the area.https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3532389/page/1#49 In non-hideout areas, the player who owns the desired spectre must be the one to use Desecrate for other players. Because Spectral Corpses replace detonatable corpses, it is not recommended to have {{il|Raise Spectre}} socketed if the player has ever raised a spectre on that character, and wants to detonate corpses for damage. Note that {{il|Raise Spectre of Transience}}, or the regular {{il|Raise Spectre}} while also equipping {{il|Soul's Wick}}, does not save spectres into the spectre bank. Monsters from [[corpse item]]s and certain other monsters such as [[Knitted Horror]]s cannot be added to the spectre bank. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Chaos

These [[Spectral Corpse]]s are now unusable for most purposes, and can only be used by [[Minion]] Skills such as {{il|Raise Spectre}} or {{il|Bone Offering}}. ** Spectral Corpses have a visual effect applied to them to help differentiate them from other corpses. ** Spectral Corpses can only spawn if you have the Raise Spectre Skill. * The maximum level of Corpses spawned is now level 20 at gem level 1 (unchanged), scaling up to 80 at gem level 20 (previously level 100). }} {{Version history table row|3.23.0| * Alternate quality gems, labyrinth helmet enchantments and unique threshold jewels are all systems that were trying to subtly modify the behaviour of skills. With this expansion these have been combined into a new system called Transfigured Gems that allows us to fully achieve the goal of these three systems, and then some. * Anomalous, Divergent and Phantasmal Quality Gems have been removed from the game. Existing alternate Quality Gems now have the base Quality effect found on the respective Gem. }} {{Version history table row|3.17.0| * {{il|Raise Spectre}}'s most recent monster types are now saved to your character and may be Desecrated. The size of this list is capped by your Spectre limit. * Desecrate and Corpse Walk now have a static 15% chance to spawn a Spectre Corpse, rather than a 2x relative weighting compared to all other possible corpse types. * Lower the life of Spectre versions of monsters that have very high life totals. Their life is being brought down to match Kitava's Herald monsters. This will affect their corpse when created with Desecrate. * Phantasmal Desecrate can now produce corpses of [[Scourge]] monsters. {{Undocumented}} }} {{Version history table row|3.16.2| * Reverted an unintended change where corpses of [[Spectre]] monsters were made to be just as likely as other corpses from Desecrate and other corpse generating skills.
